examples.text: Und so erstaunt es nicht, dass Ernst Beyeler nicht nur zu einem der erfolgreichsten Verkäufer der Werke von Paul Klee, sondern neben Daniel Henry Kahnweiler auch zum erfolgreichsten Händler von Werken Pablo Picassos arrivierte.
examples.translation: So it isn't surprising that Ernst Beyeler not only established himself as one of the most successful dealers of Paul Klee's works but also, along with Daniel Henry Kahnweiler, as the most successful distributor of paintings by Pablo Picasso.
examples.english: So it isn't surprising that Ernst Beyeler not only established himself as one of the most successful dealers of Paul Klee's works but also, along with Daniel Henry Kahnweiler, as the most successful distributor of paintings by Pablo Picasso.
